verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that https://mailchimp.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200, so an agent can be pointed at an llms.txt file. Its header ('Complete Web Content Analysis') suggests a generic site-content summary rather than curated developer or API guidance. missing for 10: evidence the llms.txt covers the Marketing/Transactional API docs, an llms-full.txt or markdown docs variant, first-party documentation of agent-oriented docs, independent hands-on corroboration of usefulness.
